defs.def: shy, awkward or ashamed, especially in a social situation 人或行为
not having any money; in a difficult financial situation 拮据的；经济困难的

ex.s: Although I was in embarrassed, his words made me a lot more relaxed!
ex.t: 虽然我当时很尴尬，但他的话让我放松了许多！

ex.s: Embarrassed and ashamed, I can’t concentrate on anything.
ex.t: 尴尬又羞愧，我无法集中注意力做任何事。

ex.s: I felt embarrassed, even though no one could see me.
ex.t: 我感到很尴尬，尽管没人能看到我。
泰尔泰尔：（有点尴尬）为什么，不……
